title: Arctic Hub
description: Arctic Hub ingests threat intelligence and customer/event data from the Arctic Security API (CERT-BE) into OpenCTI. Customers are processed individually, each producing its own STIX bundle to limit memory usage. Optionally, IPv4/IPv6 CIDR ranges can be expanded into individual host observables, and security event ingestion can be enabled in addition to the default customer data ingestion.
short_description: Ingests customer and event threat intelligence data from the Arctic Security API into OpenCTI.
